text: Made like any lactitol; the crystals are packed as unit-dose sachets. Nothing further is done to the sugar alcohol.

links.name: US patent 6,090,429: Process for the manufacture of a lactitol syrup (background)

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these. The patent's background gives the industrial hydrogenation of lactose over Raney nickel at about 100 °C and 40 bar and says crystallisation is the hard part; Wikipedia that lactitol comes as anhydrous, monohydrate and dihydrate. The sachet packing is not sourced here.
